skill.name: social-media-finder-skill
skill.description: Find public social media profiles for people, brands, or businesses using a BrowserAct workflow. The skill submits a search target, monitors the task, and returns profile details and CSV output.
skill.summary: Find public social media profiles and profile metadata through BrowserAct.
skill.author: browser-act

security_audit.summary: The skill performs expected BrowserAct workflow calls, but it reads BROWSERACT_API_KEY and sends it as bearer authentication to BrowserAct. Most Markdown backtick detections are false positives, yet the skill does instruct the agent to run a Python script and includes unsafe guidance to ask users for API keys in chat. The people-profile discovery use case creates privacy and abuse risk that should be documented and constrained.

remediation.suggestion: Do not ask users to paste API keys into chat. Require BROWSERACT_API_KEY through environment variables or a secure secret store.
Document that names, brands, and task data are sent to BrowserAct. Ask for user confirmation before each search.

remediation.issue: People lookup and contact database abuse risk
remediation.suggestion: Add clear lawful-use, consent, and public-data restrictions before enabling searches about private individuals.
Show the exact script command and BrowserAct endpoint before execution, and require confirmation for first use.

content.user_title: Find Social Media Profiles Across Platforms
content.value_statement: Finding official and related social profiles across platforms is time consuming. This skill runs a BrowserAct workflow that returns profile links, follower counts, and CSV output.
actual_capabilities: Runs a Python script that submits a BrowserAct workflow task for a name or brand.
Uses BROWSERACT_API_KEY for BrowserAct API authentication.
Polls BrowserAct task status until completion, failure, or timeout.
Retrieves workflow output with social profile details and CSV download information.
Handles invalid authorization and concurrent task limit messages.
limitations: Requires a valid BrowserAct API key and available account capacity.
Sends search targets and workflow data to BrowserAct for processing.
Results depend on BrowserAct output and public web availability.
Does not verify profile ownership or identity by itself.

use_cases.title: Candidate Public Profile Review
use_cases.description: Recruiters can collect public profile links for a named candidate after confirming a lawful purpose and appropriate consent.

use_cases.title: Prospect Social Presence Research
use_cases.description: Sales teams can find public social channels for a prospect or company before outreach.

use_cases.title: Brand Account Discovery
use_cases.description: Marketing teams can locate likely official accounts and compare presence across major platforms.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Brand Search
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner search for a known organization.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find public social media profiles for Tesla. Use the Social Media Finder skill and summarize the platforms found.

prompt_templates.title: Careful Person Search
prompt_templates.prompt: Find public profiles for Jane Doe, a conference speaker. Note possible matches and avoid claiming identity without evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Structured Prospect Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Research the public social presence for Acme Corp. Return platform names, profile URLs, follower counts, and any CSV link.

prompt_templates.title: Self Audit With Privacy Notes
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a limited search for my own public profiles under Alex Smith. Explain what data was sent to BrowserAct and list uncertain matches separately.

output_examples.output: Found likely official profiles on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. The result includes profile URLs, page titles, follower counts, and a CSV download link.
Returned several possible profile matches across LinkedIn, Instagram, and X. Ownership is not verified, so each match is marked as uncertain.

best_practices: Confirm the target name, brand, and purpose before running the workflow.
Tell users that search targets are sent to BrowserAct for processing.
Review results manually before using them for outreach or decisions.
anti_patterns: Do not use the skill to investigate private people without a lawful purpose or appropriate consent.
Do not paste API keys into chat; use environment variables or secret management.
Do not treat possible profile matches as verified identity without independent review.

faq.question: Does this skill need an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires BROWSERACT_API_KEY for BrowserAct API authentication.

faq.question: What data is sent to BrowserAct?
faq.answer: The skill sends the search target, workflow parameters, task ID, and authentication data needed to run the workflow.

faq.question: Can it verify that a profile belongs to a person?
faq.answer: No. It can find possible public profiles, but a human must verify identity and ownership.

faq.question: Does it access private social media profiles?
faq.answer: No evidence found that it accesses private profiles. It relies on BrowserAct workflow results from available web data.

faq.question: What happens if a task takes a long time?
faq.answer: The script polls status for up to 15 minutes and prints timestamped updates until completion or timeout.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
